answers: design finding 1: done — Rewrote DSCLA-10's `When:` from "runner.sh processes the return value of zbuild_claim_acquire" (names the internal function and mechanism) to "a run is started on that issue" (the observable triggering action). The `Given:` already states the observable pre-condition (`zbuild:claimed is already on the issue`) and the `Then:` names the observable outcome (`pipeline.refused.claimed is emitted to the event bus`), so only the `When:` needed fixing.

test-author finding 1: not mine — The test file stopping at exit 12 before DSCLA-1's assertion ran is a test-organisation issue: the test author co-located DSCLA-9-tagged assertions (which correctly fail on the base code as [code] SPECs) in the same file ahead of DSCLA-1's assertion, so the file exits before reaching it. My SPECs are independent — DSCLA-1 and DSCLA-9 each cover a single behaviour. Which assertions belong in which test file is the test author's decision, not the design's.
